reason: I like that it is self-hosted and links back to the original posting, but I am already juggling classes and applications. Setting up a server and figuring out which sources or AI features need paid API keys feels like more work than using the boards I already know.
objection: How much setup and ongoing cost will I take on just to keep my job search organized?
would_change_my_mind: A clearly documented local setup that works without AI or paid keys, plus a short demo showing exactly where my resume and application data stays.
